Jake sees 80 spiders, each with 8 legs, so the spiders have \(80 \times 8 = 640\) legs.  
He sees 90 insects, each with 6 legs, so the insects have \(90 \times 6 = 540\) legs.  
He sees 3 rare mutant invertebrates, each with 10 legs, so they have \(3 \times 10 = 30\) legs.  
Adding these together: \(640 + 540 + 30 = 1210\) legs.

Answer: 1210
